messages:
People Ops: Drafting a 'Goal Contract' one-pager for managers + ICs to use in kickoff 1:1s. Purpose: make goals actionable, measurable, and easy to review in calibration. Share quick reactions. :paperclip:

nina: Love the name. Can we keep it to 5 fields so it's quick to paste into docs or Slack?

omar: Add an explicit "metrics + owner" line so there's no ambiguity at calibration time.

People Ops: Nice calls. Here's a compact 5-field contract + two micro-examples. Pasteable.

```
GOAL CONTRACT (pasteable, 5 lines)
1) Outcome statement (1 line): what success looks like this quarter
2) Scope & constraints (1 line): what you own / not owned / blockers
3) Metric(s) + baseline (1 line): metric, baseline, target, owner
4) Key signals (1 line): small list e.g., adoption | latency | cost
5) Ask / support needed (1 line): what you need from manager/team
```

Example 1 (product feature): "Outcome: increase Search CTR by 6% for paid users; Scope: EU A/B only; Metrics: CTR 12% -> 18% target (owner: product); Signals: engagement, retention; Ask: prioritize 2 QA sprints."

Example 2 (infra): "Outcome: reduce p95 by 15% on heavy routes; Scope: enterprise routes only; Metrics: p95 420ms -> 357ms (owner: infra); Signals: error-rate, cost-per-token; Ask: allocate 1x GPU for perf testing."

beth: Can we add a one-line 'promo hint' tag for goals that map to promotion evidence? Helps calibration.

People Ops: Added a single tag format to append: `promo-hint: {impact|leadership|scope}`. Keep it optional. Also adding a 1-line coach prompt for managers to use when reviewing goals in kickoff: "What would make this goal 'promotion-quality' in 6 months?"

coach-bot: Tip: I'll offer a slash snippet to insert the contract into 1:1 notes and the review packet. Use `/goal-contract` to paste.

omar: Suggestion: include a tiny policy note reminding managers to use `leave-adjusted` tag if IC had approved time off.

People Ops: Good catch. Update: add optional tag `scope-note: leave-adjusted (weeks active)` and guidance in the packet to prorate metrics.

nina: Approve. This will make calibration much cleaner. Ship it in the kickoff email and the manager playbook?

People Ops: Yep — will include in both. Final ask: anyone want alternate wording for senior IC vs junior IC? If not, we'll ship this standard contract and add examples per level later. :white_check_mark:
